title: cynodon dactylon var. septentrionalis
intro: Cynodon dactylon var. septentrionalis, commonly known as northern buffelgrass, is a variant of the Cynodon dactylon species, which is a type of grass native to tropical and subtropical regions. It is valued for its various health benefits, including the potential to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of northern buffelgrass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that may exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand its properties and potential applications in traditional medicine.
